state_authority.rule: pgv.phase is a compiled artifact, not a configuration file. Direct edits are illegal without CEGL-approved transition.

PHASE_2_FROZEN.description: IR identity frozen. Structural changes to protected surface prohibited without governance protocol.

REBASELINE_PENDING.description: Golden rebaseline proposed. Transition in progress.

REBASELINE_ACCEPTED.description: Rebaseline approved. Governance has authorized structural evolution.

PHASE_3_DUAL.description: Dual implementation active. Old and new implementations coexist.

PHASE_4_SWITCH.description: Switchover in progress. New implementation replaces old.

INVALID.description: Canonical state cannot be determined. Axiom A3 violation: |C(O)| != 1.

transitions.guard: PR modifies protected surface (adr001_protected_paths.txt) with REBASELINE declaration in commit
Governance approval — REBASELINE accepted in review
Switchover complete, identity frozen for next epoch
Rebaseline rejected or no longer needed
State compiler failed to produce unique canonical state (|C(O)| != 1)

invariants.description: pgv.phase must exist and be readable
Declared state must equal canonical state unless approved transition in progress
pgv.phase must not be directly modified outside CEGL-approved transition
All commits within a transition must reference the transition or governance ADR
